title: Create an image
subtitle: From your words, from pictures you send, or by changing one
description: Say what you want and your Sylo makes it: a scene, a logo idea, a card, a wallpaper. Send a few pictures and ask for something like them, or send one and say what to change: the sky, the colours, the mood, what the sign says. It shows up in your chat, square, wide or tall, and is kept in your Library. What you write and the pictures you send go only to a private service that does not keep them.
asks: Draw a hedgehog reading a newspaper in an armchair, soft watercolour
Make something like these three, but at night
Take the sofa out of this photo and put a green armchair there

story.title: A picture from a few words, or from yours
story.subtitle: Describe it, send pictures to be like, or send one to change.
